pin.description: Bounded native-page mapping of congruent 4 KiB IRIX data segments
Bounded native-page mapping of congruent 4 KiB IRIX data segments
Bounded 4 KiB IRIX data mapping and o32 regression

policy_notes: LP64 maps the preceding 4 KiB of a congruent data page: file bytes for initialized data, zeros for pure BSS. o32 and IRIX have 4 KiB pages.
LP64 rejects native-page incongruence and code/data virtual page sharing. Both kernels reject logical file overlap and byte-aligned segments.
The four original IRIX no-bounded-space cases fail while establishing the 960 MiB occupant; no mapper conclusion follows from them.
Placement differences and all record-field differences are retained per run. Backing input hashes are checked before and after each native case.
